name: Find the Shattered Hand
summary: In Orgrimmar, the Shattered Hand awaits a promising Forsaken rogue from Tirisfal Glades. The Deathstalkers send the initiate across the sea to Durotar to learn specialized arts from the clan.

sections.title: A League of Shadows
sections.body: Mennet Carkad has seen a rogue prove their worth in Tirisfal Glades. The Forsaken train their own covert order, the Deathstalkers, and their alliance with the Horde opens a path to learn darker arts. He directs promising rogues to seek the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar, joining Lordaeron’s undead operatives with Kalimdor’s orcish assassins.

sections.title: Into the Cleft of Shadow
sections.body: The journey ends beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, where warlocks, rogues, and demon-binders work out of sight. Shenthul, a Shattered Hand trainer, awaits there. The gruff troll judges the newly arrived undead agent with harsh skepticism. Reputation alone will not satisfy him; he wants to see whether the envoy has real cunning or has wasted the voyage across the Great Sea.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Find the Shattered Hand?
aliases: who starts find the shattered hand
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad, a Deathstalker trainer in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity, sends you once you prove your basic skills in Tirisfal Glades.
Shenthul is in the Cleft of Shadow, the dark chasm beneath Orgrimmar's central pathways.

faq.q: What is the relationship between the Deathstalkers and the Shattered Hand?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's intelligence network and assassination guild, while the Shattered Hand fills a similar role for the Horde in Orgrimmar. They are formal allies who share advanced training and clandestine contracts across the Horde.

faq.q: Why does Shenthul call me uninspiring?
faq.answer: Shenthul calls you uninspiring because the Shattered Hand values physical resilience and ruthless cunning. He insults newcomers to break their pride and test whether they can endure rigorous assassin training.

aliases: what comes after find the shattered hand
faq.answer: Shenthul puts you to work with Zando'zan, then sends you south toward Ratchet for field operations in the Barrens.

faq.q: Can non-Forsaken rogues get this quest?
aliases: orc rogue find the shattered hand
faq.answer: No. The Deathstalkers give this version to Forsaken rogues. Orc and troll rogues in Durotar receive an equivalent transition called 'To Orgrimmar!'.

angles.text: As a rogue, you move from local training into the Horde's wider criminal and covert network, meeting the underworld trainers in Kalimdor.
As a young Forsaken rogue, you leave local Scourge remnants in Lordaeron behind and join the Horde's heartland in Durotar.
As a member of the Horde, you see cooperation between Orgrimmar's and Undercity's secret services, beyond the frontline grunts and shamans.
